productMetafields.npx.subtitle: 500 mcg oral BPC-157 capsules with third-party raw-material COA verification.
productMetafields.npx.what_it_is: BPC-157 (Body Protection Compound-157) is a synthetic pentadecapeptide modeled on a gastric peptide fragment. This oral capsule format delivers 500 mcg per capsule for users who want a pre-measured, room-temperature alternative to reconstituted peptide vials.

npx.feel_timeline.label: Days 1-7
npx.feel_timeline.description: Most users should expect subtle, gradual changes rather than an acute stimulant-like effect.

npx.feel_timeline.label: Weeks 2-4
npx.feel_timeline.description: Consistency matters: BPC-157 is typically discussed around recovery, gut comfort, and tissue-support pathways over time.

npx.feel_timeline.label: 4+ weeks
npx.feel_timeline.description: Review response, tolerance, and whether continued use fits your protocol before extending a cycle.

productMetafields.npx.feel_note: BPC-157 is not a stimulant. Any perceived benefits are typically gradual and individual, and human oral-use data remains limited.
productMetafields.npx.how_it_works: BPC-157 is researched for effects on nitric-oxide signaling, VEGFR2-Akt-eNOS activity, angiogenesis, and tissue-repair pathways in preclinical models. Oral delivery changes the route of exposure versus subcutaneous research protocols, so product copy should stay educational and avoid promising medical outcomes.

npx.how_to_use.label: Dose
npx.how_to_use.text: Take 1 capsule (500 mcg) once daily, or as directed by a qualified professional.

npx.how_to_use.label: Timing
npx.how_to_use.text: Morning use is common. For gut-focused protocols, some users prefer fasted dosing.

npx.how_to_use.label: Cycle
npx.how_to_use.text: Common educational protocols discuss 4-8 weeks on followed by a break; individual protocols vary.

npx.how_to_use.label: Storage
npx.how_to_use.text: Store tightly closed at room temperature, away from heat, moisture, and direct light.

npx.why: 500 mcg per capsule for consistent, repeatable dosing.
No reconstitution, bacteriostatic water, syringes, or cold-chain handling.
Room-temperature storage makes the bottle easier to travel with and keep on hand.
Oral delivery is a practical format for users focused on gut-route exposure and simple daily protocols.
productMetafields.npx.safety_important: Do not use if pregnant, nursing, under 18, or if you have a medical condition without professional guidance. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use if you take medication or are managing an injury, gastrointestinal condition, inflammatory condition, or recovery protocol.
productMetafields.npx.safety_general: Use responsibly and start conservatively. Stop use and seek professional guidance if you experience an unexpected reaction. Keep out of reach of children.
productMetafields.npx.disclaimer: This product information is educational and is not medical advice. BPC-157 is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

npx.faq.q: Is this the same BPC-157 as the vial product?
npx.faq.a: It is the same peptide compound, delivered as a 500 mcg oral capsule rather than a reconstituted vial format.
No. Store the capsules at room temperature in a cool, dry place away from direct light.
The BT Lab Testing CoA verifies the identity, purity, and potency of the BPC-157 raw material used to manufacture this lot.

npx.faq.q: How is oral BPC-157 different from subcutaneous BPC-157?
npx.faq.a: The route of exposure is different. Oral capsules are simpler to use and avoid reconstitution, while subcutaneous research protocols are usually discussed separately in peptide literature.

npx.faq.q: How many servings are in the bottle?
npx.faq.a: Each bottle contains 60 capsules at 500 mcg per capsule.
